correlationNote: Codes are 2024 MAST Automatic Transmission & Transaxle tasks (ase-automatic-transmission-and-transaxle.md). Codes prefixed 'FND ' are ASE Foundational Tasks (ase-foundational-tasks.md) — required at all levels but not priority-rated, so they do not affect P-1/P-2/P-3 coverage. Source job sheets used an older NATEF numbering; every lab was re-mapped to 2024 IDs.

labs.title: Disassemble, inspect, service, and reassemble an automatic transmission

steps.text: Measure input-shaft end play and record
Disassemble the transmission/transaxle into major units per procedure; keep in order
Clean and inspect planetary gearsets (mesh, splines, carriers, end play)
Clean and inspect thrust washers, bearings, and bushings
Inspect shafts, output shaft, and driving shells for wear/damage
[Valve body] disassemble, clean, inspect valves/bores/check balls; reassemble and torque
[Servo & accumulator] remove covers/pistons/springs; inspect seals, bores, pistons
[Case] clean and inspect passages, bores, sealing surfaces, valve-body deck warpage, threads, vents
[Apply devices] inspect overrunning clutches, bands, clutch packs (steels/frictions/pressure plates/springs/drums)
Reassemble clutch packs with new seals; measure clutch pack clearance
Air test clutch packs and servo assemblies
[Parking pawl] inspect pawl, pivot, spring, actuating rod
[Oil pump] inspect and measure pump gears/clearances; reseal; torque
Reassemble transmission/transaxle; verify input shaft turns; band adjust; install converter
